channel.title: Topic movers · UN Audience Intelligence Atlas
channel.description: The Topic Explorer's daily movers list: which of the tracked UN-relevant topics are rising or falling in worldwide Wikipedia attention, published figures only. Decision support, not a measure of media coverage or public opinion.

item.title: Topic movers 2026-08-18: Dengue fever +3771%, Inflation +965%, International Criminal Court -63%
item.description:
Topic movers, measured through 2026-08-18: attention in the 7 days to that date compared with the prior 30 days.

Rising

  • Dengue fever +3771%
  • Inflation +965%
  • Food security +792% (driven by Chinese Wikipedia)
  • Digital divide +397%
  • Debt relief +165%

Falling

  • International Criminal Court -63%
  • Wind power -56%
  • UNICEF -36% (driven by English Wikipedia)
  • International Court of Justice -32% (driven by English Wikipedia)
  • Computer security -32% (driven by English Wikipedia)

180 topics measured in 22 languages; 3 tracked topics could not be measured today (no current data, too little traffic, or quarantined as non-organic) and are excluded rather than scored from stale figures. Velocity is measured from Wikipedia reading patterns per language edition, volume-weighted: what people look up, not what media publish. Attention trends are decision support, never a measure of media coverage or public opinion.

Open the Topic Explorer for detail, language breakdowns and custom date ranges.
